jobs.description:
BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Business Development Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You develop and execute sales strategies, build relationships with key customers and partners, and provide technical support to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction in your assigned region.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Develop and execute sales strategies to reach ambitious sales targets 

• Build and maintain relationships with key customers and partners 

• Provide technical support to customers and partners so the technology is implemented and used successfully 

• Work with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development and operations 

• Carry out market research and competitive analysis to find opportunities for growth and differentiation 

• Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations and technical papers 

• Manage and track sales activities, forecasts and pipelines 

• Report regularly to senior management with sales figures and insights  

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 

• Travel up to 25 to 30% of the time in your assigned region to meet customers and partners 
 

• A technical bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, or a related field 

• At least 5 years of experience in a technical sales role 

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, written and verbal 

• A proven track record in developing and executing sales strategies that drive revenue growth 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 

• Able to work independently and in a team, self-motivated and results-driven 

• Fluent English is required; other languages are a plus

BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. As the technical owner of the electrical design, you bridge project requirements and practical implementation, making sure every machine is engineered to the highest quality and safety standards.
 

Electrical design and project planning
 
 

• From the conceptual phase onwards, you take part in project design meetings with multidisciplinary engineering teams 

• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the joint planning meetings 

• After the concept phase, you take ownership of the electrical descriptions and translate draft descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design 

• You design and adjust the electrical drawings in Eplan P8 and the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Pro Panel 

• You make sure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN 60204, MD, EMC, LVD and others)  

Execution and collaboration
 
 

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines 

• You follow up closely with production during assembly 

• As a senior, you develop, maintain and improve electrical design guidelines and best practices 

• You support colleagues and review schematics with them for accuracy 

• You contribute to standardisation initiatives in the department and gradually take the lead in driving them forward  

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 
 

• A master's degree in industrial sciences (electromechanics or electrotechnics), or equivalent experience 

• At least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in machine building 

• Solid knowledge of electrical standards; knowledge of UL standards is a plus 

• Good knowledge of Eplan P8; Eplan Pro Panel is a plus 

• An analytical mind and a problem solver 

• A good communicator and team player in an international environment 

• Good knowledge of English and Dutch

Our client is looking for a highly organised Customer Experience Operations Administrator to support the smooth running of its European operations. Acting as a key administrative link between Customer Care, Finance, Supply Chain, and Warehouse teams, this role offers a broad scope of responsibilities in a dynamic international environment.
 

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation operating within a highly regulated and innovative industry. From its European hub in Brussels, the company supports customers across multiple European markets, delivering high-quality solutions and services while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, collaboration, and operational excellence.
 

Description

Invoicing & Financial Administration
• Prepare, verify, and process invoices for customer service activities across European markets.
• Review work orders, service reports, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing.
• Follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
• Collaborate closely with Finance to ensure accurate and timely billing.Administrative Support
• Maintain and update administrative records and documentation.
• Ensure data accuracy within ERP and CRM systems.
• Provide administrative support to Customer Experience and Customer Care teams.
• Prepare, monitor, and manage a variety of operational documents and reports.Supply Chain & Warehouse Support
• Provide administrative back-up for spare parts order processing.
• Support logistics and warehouse administration activities.
• Assist with shipment documentation and transportation-related paperwork.
• Act as a flexible support resource during peak periods or colleague absences.International Coordination
• Communicate regularly with customers and colleagues across Europe.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between various departments and countries.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in an administrative, customer service, or commercial support role.
• Experience with invoicing or billing processes is a strong advantage.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Customer-oriented mindset and effective communication skills.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
• Flexible, proactive, and supportive team player.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with ERP systems is an advantage; SAP knowledge is considered a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• Knowledge of German is highly desirable
• Good level of English

3. Maintain and build worldwide strong network with agents. 
4. Negotiate effectively within commercial proposals to finalize sales agreements, ensuring acceptable deliverables and realistic timelines while balancing strict customer requirements with mutual commercial interests. 
5. Increase annual revenue from existing accounts by offering new products and services, identifying market opportunities and developing these into commercial solutions, and continuously evaluating the existing product range in line with 
6. Contribute to gathering relevant market intelligence by analyzing competitor products and customer feedback, and proactively adjusting commercial approaches accordingly. 
7. Collaborate closely with internal departments/teams to ensure the highest product quality and performance in order to fully meet customer expectations. 
8. Initiate and personally follow up on new R&D projects based on market perspectives and customer requirements. 
9. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
10. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
11. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
12. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
13. Ensure accurate (pre-)sales administration, including quotation management, technical support coordination, contract compliance, sales order booking, lead-time and deliverable tracking, communication with support departments, customer payment follow-up, and non-conformity processes. 
14. Maintain up-to-date theoretical and practical technical knowledge relevant to the segment. 
15. Achieve segment sales results by meeting budgeted revenue and sales targets. 
16. Position Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert at the center of the offshore lifting ecosystem, building positive relationships with lifting engineers, rigging specialists, operators, and other stakeholders to ensure our products are widely accepted and specified in tenders.

management roles.

• Ability to analyze key sales data and translate findings into actionable business strategies. 
• Self-starter, able to work independently with minimal supervision, while also being a team player.

• Proficiency with CRM/ERP systems and Microsoft Office.

Qualifications and Education

jobs.occupation: Operator Automotive | Protection & Finishing of New Vehicles
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities

 
• Clean and prepare vehicles before treatment
 
• Mask components that should not be coated
 
• Apply protective coatings using professional spraying equipment
 
• Perform quality checks on finished vehicles
 
• Report any irregularities or defects
 
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

Who Are We Looking For?

 
• You enjoy physical and hands-on work
 
• You have an eye for detail and take pride in delivering quality work
 
• You communicate fluently in either English or Dutch
 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence and are comfortable driving both manual and automatic vehicles
 
• You are reliable, eager to learn, and enjoy working as part of a team
 
• Experience in automotive, production, vehicle maintenance, bodywork, or spray painting is an advantage, but not required

The role

• You will join the Business Process Team and shape how network operations work.
• End-to-end processes that drive network transformation and automation are yours to design, improve and govern.
• Business stakeholders, operational teams and technical teams find their connection in you, as you translate business needs into clear processes, requirements and functional specifications.
• Using the BPMN 2.0 standard, you model AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
• KPIs help you monitor process performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, automation and customer experience.
• Your scope covers the network lifecycle, from planning and rollout to activation, service assurance, maintenance and sometimes phase-out.
• Complex challenges become clear, effective processes that support efficient, scalable and future-ready telecom operations.

Desired profile

• Experience in process management, continuous improvement or business analysis, preferably in telecommunications
• Experience managing cross-functional projects, including adoption and organizational change
• The following are an asset:
• hands-on experience with BPMN 2.0 and ARIS or a comparable modelling tool
• good knowledge of telecom networks, or the curiosity and drive to quickly build and apply this knowledge
💡 Your skills

• Business needs are something you gather, challenge and translate into process and functional requirements.
• Workshops, interviews, process reviews and gap analyses are familiar ground, and you facilitate them with ease.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills help you move topics forward.
• Operational teams, tool owners, and process and IT architects all find in you a good partner to work with.
• Strong communication in Dutch and/or French is combined with a working knowledge of English.
🌟 Who are you?

• Autonomous and assertive, with natural leadership
• A strong communicator with a customer-oriented mindset
• Flexible, both in business and technical matters
• Rigorous in your approach

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Copper Phase Out - Telecom
jobs.description:

Desired profile

• Full professional proficiency in French, Dutch and English, both spoken and written
• Good understanding of, or willingness to learn, telecom platforms, customer access technologies and provisioning flows

• previous involvement in cross-functional or transformation projects

• Complex technical cases don't put you off: you analyse them and propose migration solutions.
• New internal tools and systems for migration and network transformation are quickly mastered.
• Strong communication and coordination skills help you collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
• Your organisational skills allow you to manage diverse topics simultaneously.
🌟 Who are you?

• A problem solver with a proactive attitude, who takes ownership of actions
• Customer-oriented, structured and reliable

Department of Biomedical Sciences – Trypanosoma Unit 
 

For a more detailed research context, please refer to the PDF document.
 

Your role:
 

 · Develop an innovative and internationally competitive research programme on trypanosomes, with a strong foundation in fundamental parasite biology and/or host–parasite–vector interactions.
 

· Develop, apply and disseminate state-of-the-art experimental approaches in fundamental research, which may include advanced molecular biology, biochemistry, imaging, cell biology, multi-omics and/or computational methods, according to the candidate’s expertise and research interest.
 

· Be willing to take responsibility for and further develop the unit’s existing translational and applied research portfolio, including its contribution to HAT diagnosis, molecular surveillance and control programmes, as well as the scientific use and maintenance of its tsetse fly facility.
 

· Establish and foster strong global partnerships and collaborations.
 

· Acquire competitive research funding and build up international reputation and visibility.
 

· Contribute actively to the development and delivery of the educational portfolio of the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM, including supervision of Master students and PhD training.
 

· Build and lead a team of scientific and technical staff, take up management responsibilities appropriate to the academic level.
 

· Collaborate with other units in the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM to develop complementary research lines on vector-borne and protozoan diseases.
 

· Contribute expertise to national and international bodies and stakeholders, where relevant to the candidate’s field.
 

· Oversee and direct ITM’s WHO Collaborating Centre for Research and Training on Human African Trypanosomiasis Diagnostics.
 

· Promote and contribute to the strategic vision of the department and to relevant ITM committees.

Profile / Requirements
 

· A PhD degree in biology, veterinary sciences, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, medicine, or equivalent field. 
 

· An excellent research profile in experimental/molecular parasitology of Trypanosomatids. 
 

· Experience with advanced experimental and/or computational approaches relevant to the proposed research programme. 
 

· A proven track record of successful grant writing and project supervision, in accordance with the candidate’s career stage. 
 

· A collaborative scientific profile and ability to develop interdisciplinary and international collaborations. 
 

· Experience in translational or applied research, capacity strengthening, and collaboration with institutions in endemic countries is considered an asset. 
 

· Prior experience in running a tsetse fly facility is not essential, though an interest in helping to run and utilize the tsetse facilities is considered an asset. 
 

· Experience in academic teaching and training in the field of parasitology is highly valued. 
 

· Excellent communication skills and respectful people management skills. 
 

· Fluent in English. Knowledge of French is an asset. Active knowledge of Dutch is desirable. If you do not have these skills, willingness to acquire a working level of Dutch is requested. 
 

· You support the mission and values of the ITM.

To support our further growth ambitions, brantsandpatents is looking for
 a Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities of your clients and advise them on how to protect their innovations through an appropriate IP strategy, which you will then put into practice.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors, -attorneys and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You’ll work from our office in Ghent.
 

 

You have or are...
 
 

• A master’s degree (MSc) in chemistry, chemical engineering or similar, with a strong preference for organic chemistry. A PhD is a nice to have. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• The ambition and drive to build a career in IP and to qualify as a patent attorney.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

Our client is looking for a Rail Transportation & Logistics Coordinator to ensure the smooth execution of rail transportation activities across Europe. This position offers a unique mix of operational coordination, issue resolution, and performance monitoring within a fast-paced international environment.

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Drive business growth in the German market by identifying new opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing the full sales cycle. Commercial experience is a plus, not a must: motivated juniors with strong German and English skills are welcome to apply for this 100% on-site role in Antwerp.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

 

Omschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.
 

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan.
